title: Check the endpoints
text: At $$x=\frac{1}{\pi}$$ or $$x=\frac{-1}{\pi}$$, the absolute values of the terms are $$\frac{1}{k^{\pi}}$$.

title: Compare with a known series
text: The sum of $$\frac{1}{k^{\pi}}$$ converges because $$\pi>1$$, so the series converges absolutely at both endpoints. The interval is $$[\frac{-1}{\pi},\frac{1}{\pi}]$$.
